scope: All 150 reviewed sostoj-family composition predicates in the four post-EDIT-0013 Latin components: 143 exact edits, seven already-canonical retained uses, and five sentence-specific recasts for non-iz senses.
choice: Retain the official pan-Slavic sostojati se iz family, normalize every inflected form to the project surface, require the reflexive se and iz government for composition, and recast the five non-composition calques instead of forcing them into the lemma.
motivation: Official dictionary entry 1874 supplies sostojati se iz and positive evidence for every listed Slavic group. Replacing the whole family with skladati se iz would reduce Bulgarian and Serbian coverage; retaining malformed national forms or omitting se would preserve avoidable grammar defects. Every occurrence was reviewed in its mathematical sentence, so no linguistic hold remains in this family.
alternatives_rejected: Replace the whole family with skladati se iz, despite its weaker South-Slavic profile.
Keep Russian-shaped sostojit/sostojat/sostojut or mixed accented forms.
Keep bare sostoji without the required reflexive se.
Force the five senses meaning consists in or the problem lies in into iz-government rather than recasting them semantically.
Leave the family for a hypothetical future human instead of completing the best evidence-bound edition now.

official_dictionary_dataset.accepted_profile: bg+ hr+ pl+ ru+ sk+ sr+ uk+

validation.coordinates: 143/143 exact character and UTF-8 byte offsets, line/column positions, old/new hashes, anchors, and non-overlap
validation.protected_content: zero edit intersections; comment and foreign-span sequence unchanged
validation.structure: cross-reference, environment, and math-delimiter sequences unchanged
validation.outputs: 4/4 planned byte counts and SHA-256 values reproduced before write and verified after write
validation.residue: zero malformed or national sostoj forms; zero bare canonical predicates; zero se-sostoji inversion; zero sostoj-family se v government

uncertainty: This is an evidence-bound editorial decision, not a claim of native review. The exact alternatives and source-family limitations remain preserved in the plan and this record.
